zh: 比较字典序时，越靠前的位置越重要；删掉一个字符后，结果和原串的第一个不同位置出现在被删位置附近。
如果某处 s[i]>s[i+1]，删掉 s[i] 能让这个位置变小；在第一个这样的下降处删除最好。如果整个串不下降，删任何非末尾字符都不会更小，删最后一个字符最好。
从左到右找第一个满足 s[i]>s[i+1] 的 i；找到就删除 s[i]，找不到就删除最后一个字符，输出剩余的字符串。
en: In lexicographic order earlier positions matter most; after deleting one character, the first place the result differs from the original string is near the deleted position.

If s[i]>s[i+1] somewhere, deleting s[i] makes that position smaller, and the first such descent is the best place to delete. If the string never decreases, deleting any non-final character cannot help, so delete the last character.
Scan left to right for the first i with s[i]>s[i+1]; if it exists delete s[i], otherwise delete the last character, and print what remains.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Delete at the first position whose character is strictly greater than the next one; if there is no descent, delete the last character.

## Proof of correctness

Before the first descent the characters are non-decreasing, so deleting an earlier position is no better than keeping the smaller current character; deleting at the first descent makes the first differing position smaller. When there is no descent, keeping the longest prefix and deleting the last character is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(N), output space O(N).
